title: A+B (sanity check)
statement_md:
Given two integers A and B on a single line, print their sum.

**Input**
One line: `A B` (-10^9 <= A, B <= 10^9)

**Output**
A single integer: A + B.
hints: Read two integers from a single line.
Print their sum followed by a newline.
Use 64-bit integers: values up to 1e9 fit in 32-bit, but their sum can overflow it in some languages.
